name: quadruped wrist rock
description: On hands and knees, you rock your shoulders forward and back over your hands. It warms up the wrists before push-ups and hand balancing.
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Spread your fingers and press your palms into the floor.
Shift your shoulders forward past your hands slowly.
Rock back until your hips move toward your heels.
Turn your hands to point sideways or backward for more stretch.
